title: STORY COLLECTION: A LIGHT SPARK IN DARKNESS OPEN
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: A LIGHT SPARK IN DARKNESS OPEN
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Wage Tickets, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: A Light Spark in Darkness event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Wage Tickets by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Thrift Shop. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
0011 Tempest Series - Take a Leap for Jackie, Information Fragments, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Recruitment Permits, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Special Operation. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
